research_method: Business discovered through public web research and published only from company-owned pages. County coverage and services are limited to what the provider explicitly states; no ratings, reviews, or inferred service areas are used as evidence.
ordering_policy: Ordinary listings are neutrally ordered. Sponsored placement must be labeled and paid links must use rel=sponsored.

providers.license_information: The company-owned website states that the business holds Texas OSSF Installer II, service-contract-provider, and waste-hauler licensing. Verify current state credentials, local registration, insurance, and authorized service scope before hiring.
providers.coverage_notes: The company-owned website explicitly lists Denton, Tarrant, and Wise counties in its service area and describes septic and aerobic tank pumping/cleaning, conventional and aerobic system installation, repairs, annual aerobic inspection service, and pump/compressor maintenance.
